Context Summary:
Feature branch 15-file-operations-progress-indicator-2, uncommitted working tree. Automated coverage is queue_test.go (13 tests, run with -race); the TUI itself cannot be exercised non-interactively.</context_summary>
<parameter name="reasoning">User manually ran the app and queued three file copies in opposite directions (left->right and right->left) simultaneously. Reported working correctly.

This matters because it exercises exactly the paths no test covers, the TUI being non-interactive from a shell:
  - serial dispatch through pumpQueue under multiple rapid enqueues, where the startedAt dispatch-marker guard is what prevents double-dispatch;
  - opFinishedMsg reloading BOTH panes rather than just the active one, which is required precisely when queued operations target opposite directions (a copy right-to-left changes the left pane while the user's cursor is on the right);
  - the bottom-right widget's "+N" pending count and its handoff from one running op to the next as the queue drains.

No code change resulted; recording it so a future session knows this path was verified by hand rather than assuming it is untested territory.</parameter>
<parameter name="response">Confirmed working by manual test. No changes made.
